# equals

<link-summary>Compares two values deeply and null-safely.</link-summary>

<web-summary>equals() — Compares two values deeply and null-safely. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/object</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function equals(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean;
```

Objects and arrays are walked key by key, dates by their instant, and primitives by `SameValueZero` — so `NaN` equals `NaN`, which `===` never grants. A value carrying its own `equals` method is asked instead of being taken apart.

Cycles are tolerated: a structure that refers back to itself is compared without looping.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description       |
| :-------- | :-------- | :---------------- |
| `a`       | `unknown` | The first value.  |
| `b`       | `unknown` | The second value. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the two are equal all the way down.

## Examples

### Comparing

```javascript
equals({ a: 1 }, { a: 1 }); // => true
equals([1, { a: 2 }], [1, { a: 2 }]); // => true
equals(NaN, NaN); // => true
equals(new Date(0), new Date(0)); // => true
```
